contents_summary: ZIP of two members: a 10-page supplementary PDF (methods, primer table, ExAC population-frequency tables, references) and a six-sheet workbook of whole-exome family variant tables (sequencing metrics, variant summaries, proband coding SNPs and indels, proband inheritance counts, sibling coding SNPs). Only the proband inheritance-count table carries patient-level results that are transcribed.

pages.contents: Supplementary methods: human participant recruitment and consent statement, DNA collection and extraction, whole-exome sequencing at an outside sequencing centre, and a bioinformatics pipeline overview flowchart with caption (raw data, filtering, mapping, duplicate marking, realignment, recalibration, variant calling, filtering, annotation).
pages.clinical_relevance_notes: Study administration and laboratory methods; no patient results.
limitations: Printed IRB protocol number and investigator name are not transcribed.
